desc:
Sonic inspired +1 game!

⚡ Become the fastest runner in +1  Sonic Evolve!, collect rings and race at incredible speeds!

💨 Train your speed and become faster  
💍 Collect rings as you explore  
🎁 Earn awesome playtime rewards  
🔥 Build your daily login streak  
⭐ Climb the leaderboards

Keep running, keep grinding, and prove that you're the fastest hedgehog around! 🦔⚡

(Not affiliated with SEGA, expect changes in the future.)
